title: heleniastrum puberulum
intro: Heleniastrum puberulum, commonly known as Bhringaraj, is a medicinal plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including skin and scalp problems, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bhringaraj include promoting hair growth, reducing dandruff and itchiness, and improving skin conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
